g.text: Endless world: building, swapping and generating chunks
Walk rings 0..buildRadius (2) around the player's chunk,
swapOutChunk: write elements of the chunk
and what they carry to chunk_x_y.bin
Seed from the world seed and the chunk
Lock the world mutex, batch teleporter registration
Fence: nothing may reach outside this chunk
tiled from the top left cell
else one on the floor nearest the middle
buildChunkWalls: west and north walls with gaps,
open the cell next to every gap
keys, guns, apples, landmines, teleporters, doors
